stories.headline: Trump names Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff
body: Trump picked longtime adviser Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff.
Miller is seen as the architect of Trump's mass deportation policy.
Democrats, who take Congress in January, are expected to investigate his role.
stories.vc: A hardline chief of staff signals more clashes with Congress, raising policy uncertainty.

stories.headline: Pope Leo starts a 12-day South America tour after cancer surgery
body: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Uruguay to begin a 12-day tour of three South American countries.
It comes three weeks after he had lung cancer surgery.
He told reporters he feels fairly good.
stories.vc: Papal visits bring big tourism and security spending for host cities.

stories.headline: Macao jails ex-lawmaker in its first national security case
body: Former pro-democracy lawmaker Au Kam San got 12.5 years in prison in Macao.
It is the first known case under Macao's 2009 national security law.
The trial was held behind closed doors.
stories.vc: Security crackdowns add political risk for businesses in Macao and Hong Kong.

stories.headline: Cyberattacks on fridges hit a French blood bank
body: A health-sector security group warned of attacks on refrigeration controllers.
One incident affected a major French blood bank.
The attacks target controllers from specific refrigeration brands.
stories.vc: Hospitals may need to spend more securing connected equipment, not just computers.

stories.headline: Mamaearth maker Honasa's profit jumps 87%
body: Honasa Consumer's quarterly profit rose 87% to ₹73.2 crore.
Revenue grew 36% to ₹731 crore, its fastest growth since listing.
Both fell slightly from the previous quarter.
stories.vc: A rebound at Honasa supports investor faith in listed D2C brands.

stories.headline: MobiKwik gets RBI licence to lend directly
body: MobiKwik's subsidiary got RBI approval to run as an NBFC, a kind of lending company.
It plans to start lending within three to six months.
It targets ₹5,000 crore of loans over three to four years.
stories.vc: An NBFC licence lets MobiKwik keep more of each loan's earnings.

stories.headline: Angel One overtakes Zerodha as Groww grows its lead
body: Angel One moved to second place among Indian brokers, adding about 2.4 lakh users in October.
Groww leads with 1.38 crore active users and a 30% share.
Total active users dipped 0.5% to 4.59 crore.
stories.joke: The broker leaderboard moves faster than the Nifty.
stories.vc: Consolidation in broking favours app-first players with low costs.
